source_text: Post Gai Iesus aedificat altare Deo in monte Hebal de lapidibus integris non ferro tactis — lex in lapidibus. Holocaustum et pacifica. Forma cultus veri post hostes prostratos.
pass_a_gloss: After Ai Jesus builds altar to-God on mount Ebal from stones whole not by-iron touched — law on stones. Burnt-offering and peace-offerings. Form of-worship true after enemies laid-low.
pass_b_english: After Ai [[Jesus builds an altar to God on Mount Ebal of whole stones untouched by iron >> Bible:Joshua 8:30-31]] — the law written on stones. Burnt offering and peace offerings. True worship’s form after enemies fall.
